findings.title: Unclear description for pauschal position
findings.message: The short and long texts are empty, providing no definition of the scope. This violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires clear and exhaustive descriptions.
findings.suggestion: Add a detailed description of the work, specifying material, execution method and performance criteria.

findings.title: Missing technical specification for meter‑tape work
findings.message: No short or long text is provided, so the exact nature of the 6.25 Mt work is undefined. This leads to potential disputes under VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6.
findings.suggestion: Specify the type of work (e.g., excavation, backfilling), material class, and any relevant standards (e.g., DIN 18331).

findings.title: Unclear reference to "Verkehrsrechtlicher Anordnung"
findings.message: The long text only contains a fragment "31Anach 'Verkehrsrechtlicher Anordnung'" without any explanation of the required measures, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Provide a complete description of the traffic‑law related measures, required signage, and any temporary road‑use permissions.

findings.title: Missing material and dimension specifications for linear work
findings.message: Only a quantity (500 m) and unit price are given; there is no indication of the material, cross‑section, or applicable norm (e.g., DIN 18331). This breaches the STLB‑Bau‑Standardtext requirements.
findings.suggestion: Add material type, class, dimensions, and reference to the applicable norm.

findings.title: Unit mismatch for earthwork quantity
findings.message: Quantity is given in metres (m) while the work likely concerns volume (m³). This inconsistency can cause calculation errors.
findings.suggestion: Verify whether the intended unit is linear metres or cubic metres and correct the unit accordingly.

findings.title: Missing technical description for surface work
findings.message: No short or long text is provided for 3600 m² at €0.05 per unit, making the scope undefined and uncalculable.
findings.suggestion: Specify the type of surface work (e.g., paving, grading), material class, and any performance standards.

findings.title: Missing material class for bulk material
findings.message: The position lists 6800 m³ with a unit price but no material specification (e.g., sand, gravel) or quality class, violating STLB‑Bau requirements.
findings.suggestion: Add material type, class, and any required test criteria.

findings.title: Unplausibly low unit price for large volume
findings.message: 550 m³ at €28.50 per m³ results in €15,675 total, which is unusually low for the indicated work, indicating a possible pricing error.
findings.suggestion: Check the calculation and compare with market rates; adjust the unit price if necessary.

findings.title: Missing separate charge for soil preparation
findings.message: The note indicates that soil must be processed with a shovel separator or mixed with binding material, but no separate position for this preparation is listed, which should be a special service per VOB/C § 4.2.
findings.suggestion: Create an additional position for soil preparation as a special service.

findings.title: Missing description for low‑price volume work
findings.message: No textual description is provided for 1655 m³ at €0.05 per unit, making the scope undefined and risking disputes.
findings.suggestion: Add a clear description of the work, material, and execution standards.

findings.title: Unit price mismatch for single cubic metre
findings.message: A single cubic metre is priced at €125.00, which is dramatically higher than adjacent positions (e.g., €0.68 for 50 m³). This suggests a unit error or mis‑allocation.
findings.suggestion: Verify whether the intended quantity is 1 m³ or 1 t, and correct the unit price accordingly.

findings.title: Potential risk transfer for high‑value equipment rental
findings.message: The position lists 8 St at €50 each without specifying whether the contractor must provide the equipment. This may shift the risk of procurement to the contractor unlawfully.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether the equipment is supplied by the client or the contractor and adjust the contract accordingly.
